questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All keys are locks.

All locks are handles.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some locks are keys.

II. All keys are handles.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d444f47c6063094c077eb0b5925605b4a4444e8555f8b7016d8359649e2a1a7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some locks are keys → Follow (As all keys are locks. As whole keys comes in locks, therefore it is true.)

II. All keys are handles → Follow (As all keys are locks and all locks are handles. As whole keys comes in locks which whole comes in handles, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Rocks : Mountain :: Grass : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Environment and its components**.

Here,

Rocks : Mountain → **Rocks** are components of a **Mountain**.

Similarly,

Grass : Garden → **Grass** is a component of a **Garden**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a straight row facing north. Only two people sit to the left of D. Only two people sit between D and E. F sits to the immediate right of C. A sits to the immediate left of B. B is not a neighbour of D. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
questions.solution:
Given: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a straight row facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of D.

2) Only two people sit between D and E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e377be93a11aab1b0aafb9315e0545346cc1002ab597394625cad860367ed096.png] 

3) B is not a neighbour of D.

4) A sits to the immediate left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07c7bbc1588ecbc0f4ec5e740e87e4e75ff2d0a95a8f429464a1b6f79c65a2fb.png] 

5) F sits to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1df246c8571a63751632687737cbe8895b6188aabea07dd37a8d307ecaacefd3.png] 

Thus, **C** sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

21 ∶ 35 ∶∶ ? ∶ 31 ∶∶ 23 ∶ 37
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 14 = 2nd number

Now,

For, 21 : 35

⇒ 21 + 14 = 35.

For, 23 : 37

⇒ 23 + 14 = 37.

Similarly, for ? ∶ 31

**⇒ ? + 14 = 31.**

**⇒ ? = 31 - 14 = 17.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
If @ denotes ÷, # denotes ×, $ denotes + and % denotes −, then what will be the value of the following equation?

9 # 2 @ 2 $ 9 % 9 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 9 # 2 @ 2 $ 9 % 9 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 #
 $
 %
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 9 ×__** 2 ÷ 2**__ + 9 - 9 = ?

⇒ __**9**____** ×**____** 1**__ + 9 - 9 = ?

⇒ __**9 + 9**__ - 9 = ?

⇒ __18** - 9**__ = **9**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3".
